title: Graduate Analyst Programme - Capabilities
description:
About Baringa 

Baringa is a global consulting firm that partners with leaders to drive change and create value. With deep industry expertise, and enabled by advanced technology, the firm helps clients to deliver with greater confidence and certainty. With over 2,000 people across the UK, Europe, North America, Asia and Australia, the firm combines global insight with local understanding.

The firm works across energy and resources, financial services, government and public sector, consumer products and retail, pharmaceuticals and life sciences, manufacturing, and technology, media and telecoms, with capabilities spanning strategy, transformation and operational excellence - all powered by advanced technology, data, AI and digital innovation.

Clients value Baringa’s collaborative approach and the way its teams integrate seamlessly - all working with a shared understanding of what matters most. The firm is known for its kind, curious experts who listen closely and care deeply about client success as they help clients transform energy markets, modernise financial platforms, expand telecoms and digital networks through advanced data analytics, enable digital services in government, and unlock growth in consumer sectors.

Certified as a  Great Place to Work around the world, Baringa has been recognised by the Financial Times in 22 categories of its UK Leading Management Consultants rankings, and by Forbes for four consecutive years as one of the World’s Best Management Consulting Firms.

Our Graduate Analyst Programme

Our Graduate Analyst role offers the opportunity to start and grow your career at Baringa. As a permanent member of our team from day one, you'll work on a variety of real client and internal projects, develop valuable skills, and make a meaningful contribution from the outset.

You'll work alongside experienced consultants, building both your technical and professional capabilities through structured learning, hands-on experience, and ongoing development opportunities. Along the way, you'll build relationships across the business, collaborate with colleagues from different teams and sectors, and contribute to work that makes a real impact.

If you're a recent graduate looking to kick-start your career, Baringa offers a supportive and collaborative environment where you can develop your skills, gain practical experience, and build a successful long-term future with us.

We're looking for Graduate Analysts to join our Capabilities practice, with opportunities available across several of our specialist business units. During the application process, you'll have the opportunity to select the business unit that best aligns with your interests and aspirations.

The business units currently hiring are:

Customer

Imagine a world where customers are delighted, employee engagement soars and costs drop. This is the power of world-class omni-channel experiences. Our expert team anticipates change, crafting innovative solutions that blend seamlessly across all touchpoints. By leveraging cutting-edge technology, we transform service delivery, minimising costs while maximising impact. Ready to enhance your market position and unlock unprecedented value? Let’s redefine excellence together.

Desired Skills: Strong communication, teamwork, and relationship-building skills. Structured problem-solving and analytical thinking. A customer-focused mindset and interest in improving customer experiences. AI and digital literacy with a curiosity for emerging technologies. Adaptability, curiosity, and a proactive approach to learning and development.

Desired Degrees: Business Management, Product Design UX & UI, and Marketing

Enterprise Value Creation

Every organisation faces moments when it needs to grow faster, operate more efficiently or respond to changing market conditions. Baringa's Enterprise Value Creation team helps clients navigate these challenges by combining strategic thinking, analytical rigour, AI-native mind

title: Multiphysics Engineer, High Speed Reacting Flow
description:
Anduril Industries is a defense technology company with a mission to transform U.S. and allied military capabilities with advanced technology. By bringing the expertise, technology, and business model of the 21st century’s most innovative companies to the defense industry, Anduril is changing how military systems are designed, built and sold. Anduril’s family of systems is powered by Lattice OS, an AI-powered operating system that turns thousands of data streams into a realtime, 3D command and control center. As the world enters an era of strategic competition, Anduril is committed to bringing cutting-edge autonomy, AI, computer vision, sensor fusion, and networking technology to the military in months, not years.

About the Team

The Multiphysics Team's work is essential to support our rapid innovation cycle and improve the performance and reliability of advanced defense technologies. Multiphysics Engineers combine computational and experimental methods to size, design, and optimize systems involving complex, coupled physics processes and environments. This team operates with full design ownership through the product development cycle, moving from system-level and first-principles models to 3D simulation and validation/product testing.

About the Job

We are looking for a Multiphysics Engineer to join our team in Costa Mesa, CA. In this role you will own the internal flow, combustion, and heat transfer analysis behind air vehicle propulsion systems.

We are looking for strong fundamentals in compressible flow and heat transfer, and a track record of quickly delivering useful results.

What You’ll Do

• Run CFD analysis of internal and high-speed flows, with and without combustion

• Start with hand calculations and 1D models to size a design, then move to 3D CFD to refine it

• Predict heat loads, surface temperatures, and pressures for the thermal and structural teams

• Set up gas properties and chemistry appropriate to the conditions being modeled

• Support rocket nozzle, insulation, and case design decisions with analysis

• Build and document repeatable workflows so other engineers can run the same analysis

• Compare predictions against static fire and ground test data and improve the models

• Support material response and erosion analysis in high-temperature environments

• Work with aerodynamics, thermal, structures, materials, and test engineers

• Present results at design reviews and document the analysis

Required Qualifications

• Master’s degree in Aerospace engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Chemical Engineering, Engineering Physics, or a related field

• Ability to obtain and maintain a U.S. secret security clearance

• 5+ years of experience in CFD, aerothermal, thermal, or combustion analysis

• Foundational understanding of compressible flow including shocks, choked flow, and supersonic nozzles

• Strong first-principles understanding of heat transfer and fluid dynamics, including conduction, convection, radiation, fluid flow, and transient thermal behavior

• Experience with commercial CFD code such as STAR-CCM+, Fluent, or similar, including meshing and driving a case to convergence

• Proficient in applying hand calculations and 1D models to independently validate CFD results

• Programming experience in Python, MATLAB, or similar

• Clear technical writing and the ability to present results to customers

• Passion for defending the United States and her allies

Preferred Qualifications

• PhD in a related field

• Active U.S. Secret or Top Secret security clearance

• Experience with solid rocket motors, propulsion systems, or energetic materials

• Experience with reacting flow modeling - finite-rate or equilibrium chemistry and species transport

• Experience with chemistry and gas property tools such as NASA CEA, Cantera, or CHEMKIN

• Experience selecting solvers and flux schemes for shock-dominated flows

• Experience with high-temperature or high-enthalpy flow

• Experience with ablative or ch

description:
Joining Mines Saint-Étienne means committing to an institution where science and innovation build a more sustainable future. It is a school of excellence where everyone has the opportunity to unlock their full potential and contribute to tackling the challenges of tomorrow.
Ranked among the top engineering schools in France and recognized worldwide, our school, a member of the Institut Mines-Télécom , educates the talents of tomorrow while actively addressing major industrial, digital, and environmental challenges. By joining us, you become part of a community of 500 members of staff, 2,500 students and take part in an ambitious project: combining academic excellence, cutting-edge research, and positive societal impact.

Together, we imagine and build a sustainable future by educating the leaders who will shape tomorrow’s transitions.

🎯 What we expect from you

As a Postdoctoral Researcher or Research Engineer, you will perform research and innovation activities in the field of soft electronics and optical sensing for artificial skin applications. Within the Centre of Microelectronics and the Flexible Electronics Department (FEL), you will contribute to the development of stretchable optical waveguides and their integration into artificial skin demonstrators.
The flexible electronics department develops technological and scientific knowledge in the field of soft electronics. The department has a strong knowledge in the field of material and interface electrical and mechanical characterization. The activities of the department are regrouped in the 660m2-area platform. This technological platform regroups facilities and technological equipment for R&D activities in Micropackaging, micro and nano-electronics, in a clean room of 220m² 1000-class and 400m² 10000-class.

Stretchable electronics can also be combined with optical systems such as waveguides. These devices will be developed to create artificial skin with pressure and temperature sensing capabilities.
Within this project, the work will focus on the fabrication and characterization of stretchable optical waveguides, as well as on fabrication and integration techniques for optical components (LEDs / photodiodes). A related publication is “Transparent, Optical, Pressure-Sensitive Artificial Skin for Large-Area Stretchable Electronics” (https://doi.org/10.1002/adma.201200523).
The main activities will include:
· Fabrication and characterization of elastomer waveguides for pressure and temperature sensing applications.
· Integration of optically pressure- or temperature-sensitive materials into the elastomer waveguides.
· Characterization and validation of complete sensing devices.
The fabrication processes and experimental setups are already available. However, good knowledge of Python is important for operating and further developing the test benches. Hands-on laboratory work is essential and will be partly performed in our clean room facility.
The expected outcome is the demonstration of radically new soft optical sensing devices with features and functions that cannot be achieved with conventional electronic approaches. This work is part of a European project involving multiple partners across Europe, including ETH Zurich (ETHZ), the University of Oxford, Johannes Kepler University Linz, EMPA…

title: ClickHouse Engineer
description:
ClickHouse Engineer
Singapore (Office-based)| Full-Time
About Us
Reactive Markets is the 2026 OTC Trading Platform of the Year (). Our network handles over $50 billion in daily trading volumes across FX, Equities, and Cryptocurrency, connecting 40+ of the world's leading liquidity providers.
We build trading systems that operate at the edge of what's technically possible - where nanoseconds matter and a dropped message costs real money. Our engineering team is small, senior, and deeply invested in the craft of building cutting edge, reliable, high-performance systems.
The Role
We're looking for a ClickHouse Engineer to share ownership of our data plant: a multi-datacentre, multi-AZ ClickHouse cluster ingesting billions of rows a day, underpinning compliance, billing, and a growing family of real-time and historical analytics.
This is a core-platform engineering role, not a DBA role. You'll work across the full engineering scope of a serious ClickHouse estate: cluster operations and upgrades, schema and sorting-key design, materialised views, ingestion performance, query optimisation, workload isolation, capacity planning, storage tiering, backup and recovery, monitoring and alerting, and production support. You'll also work on the data pipelines around the plant - our capture services are Go, and our analytics foundation is Python.
You don't need years of ClickHouse specifically - deep experience with another columnar or large-scale time-series database qualifies you, and a strong columnar engineer learns our estate quickly. What we do need is genuine operational depth: you have run a production data platform, owned its capacity plan and its recovery procedures, and stayed calm when it mattered.
This hire completes a follow-the-sun team - based in Singapore (office-based) or London - so the platform is supported across time zones rather than by heroics. On-call is a shared, contracted responsibility, planned and paid - not goodwill.
What You'll Work On

• Cluster operations at scale - running, upgrading and evolving a multi-AZ ClickHouse estate on Kubernetes, with rehearsed backup and recovery

• Schema and query engineering - table and sorting-key design, partitioning, materialised views, and query optimisation against multi-terabyte datasets

• Capacity and observability - a measured capacity model, storage tiering and retention, and the Grafana monitoring and alerting that keeps the plant's health visible

• Ingestion and data quality - correctness and completeness gates on the pipelines feeding the plant; reconciliation that proves nothing was dropped

• Workload isolation - keeping ingest, operations, reporting and ad-hoc analytics from treading on each other as read load grows

• AI-assisted operations - modern tooling (including MCP-based AI access to the estate) that lets a small team run a large platform well

What We Need
Technical:

• Columnar/OLAP database engineering - ClickHouse strongly preferred; deep experience with another columnar or large-scale time-series store (BigQuery, Redshift, Druid, kdb+ or similar) also works

• SQL depth - execution plans, query optimisation, and schema design for very large datasets

• Operational/SRE experience - you have carried production responsibility for a data platform: monitoring, capacity, incidents, recovery

• Linux and Kubernetes - comfort with the operational layer beneath the database

• A programming language - one of Python, Go, R, or MATLAB (Python preferred)

• Engineering discipline - you write proposals, strategies, and architectural documents and diagrams well, and you manage change properly

• Git - excellent version-control practice

• Distributed-systems fundamentals - replication, consistency, failure modes

• Financial services experience is a plus but not essential - domain knowledge can be learned; operational instinct cannot

How you work:

• You own production. Calm in an incident, rigorous in a post-mortem, honest about what nearly went wrong

Our vision is to create autonomy that propels the world forward.  Our intelligent, mapless, and hardware-agnostic AI products are designed for automakers, accelerating the transition from assisted to automated driving.

Gaia is Wayve's world model: trained on large-scale driving video, it predicts future frames from past context functioning as a simulator that generates synthetic scenarios, and operating in closed loop with the driving model itself. About the role
As a Senior Manager, Business Operations & Client Success, you will maintain an integrated view of Business Unit (BU) health and ensure operational, client, people, financial, and delivery signals are translated into clear priorities and actionable plans. Acting as the coordination and insight layer across the Business Unit, you will connect Delivery and Engineering leadership, Client stakeholders, HR, Talent Acquisition, Finance, and People Operations. This role reports directly to the Business Unit Managing Director / VP Delivery and focuses on high-value business insight, independent client sensing, and cross-functional execution.
As a qualified expert You will

• Own and continuously develop the Business Unit performance management framework, consolidating financial, delivery, people, hiring, quality, client, and operational indicators into an integrated view of BU health.

• Investigate underlying causes, trends, and business implications beyond reporting metrics, translating observations into recommendations, corrective actions, and tracked resolutions.

• Own the BU-level Client Success and client health framework, developing mechanisms to measure sentiment (including NPS and qualitative/quantitative signals) through direct stakeholder conversations and interviews.

• Maintain operational governance across Financial Operations (budgeting, forecasting, compensation/rate exceptions), Hiring Operations (priorities and bottlenecks), People Operations, and Reporting Data accuracy.

• Provide BU leadership with an independent perspective on client and business health, complementing Delivery and Engineering leadership without replacing their ownership of client relationships.

• Ensure material business risks, key decisions, and operational roadblocks reach leadership early enough for effective action.

We're looking for you if you have

• 5+ years of relevant experience in Business Operations, Client Success, Strategic Program Management, Delivery Operations, or a similar cross-functional role within IT or professional services.

• Experience working across multiple business functions, such as Delivery, Engineering, HR, Talent Acquisition, Finance, and People Operations.

• Experience with client health and success practices, including NPS/CSAT, client sentiment, or structured client health reviews.

• Hands-on experience with operational and financial management, including budgeting, forecasting, variance analysis, and invoicing oversight.

• Strong analytical skills and the ability to consolidate financial, delivery, people, client, and operational data into a clear view of Business Unit health.

• Ability to take ambiguous business problems, structure them into actionable initiatives, and drive execution across multiple stakeholders.

• Strong risk identification and problem-solving skills, with the ability to spot early warning signals

Synthesia is the world’s leading AI video platform for business, used by over 90% of the Fortune 100. Founded in 2017, the company is headquartered in London, with offices and teams across Europe and the US.

As AI continues to shape the way we live and work, Synthesia develops products to enhance visual communication and enterprise skill development, helping people work better and stay at the center of successful organizations.

Following our recent Series E funding round, where we raised $200 million, our valuation stands at $4 billion. Our total funding exceeds $530 million from premier investors including Accel, NVentures (Nvidia's VC arm), Kleiner Perkins, GV, and Evantic Capital, alongside the founders and operators of Stripe, Datadog, Miro, and Webflow.

ABOUT THE ROLE

Almost any company can produce training video at scale today. Almost none can tell you whether it actually made someone better at their job. We're building the product that closes that gap: an agentic, real-time experience where people practice live, dynamic scenarios, and where organizations finally get genuine signal on readiness, instead of a metric tied to course completion. This is a zero-to-one bet on what comes after content, which is practice, and proof.

You'll own one of two of the domains inside that bet, Surveys and Guidance, from strategy through ship.

WHY NOW

Real-time, agentic AI has only just become good enough to hold a convincing live scenario, and to make sense of what happens inside one. The window to define this category is open now, and we intend to own it.

THE PROBLEM YOU'RE SOLVING

Today, the most a company can do to check whether someone has genuinely learned something is watch them complete a module or pass a quiz. The behaviors that matter in real roles, in real moments, are rarely tested reliably, and what comes back to the business is a thin, lagging signal.

We have the underlying technology to change that. What we need is a product manager who can turn it into something an enterprise will use to prepare its people, and that an end user actually wants to engage with, across two connected domains:

- Surveys - capturing structured, trustworthy signal at scale: how people feel, how they're performing, and where the gaps are.

- Guidance - giving people direction in the moment they need it, live and in context, rather than as a debrief after the fact.

Both sit inside the same bet: give organizations proof of readiness, not just proof of attendance.

- Owning the multi-quarter strategy for Surveys and Guidance, setting the direction, identifying the right problems to solve, and making the trade-offs needed to deliver against them.

- Defining and evolving the success metrics for both domains, and connecting product outcomes directly to commercial results: retention, expansion, and revenue impact.

- Getting close to the customers who matter most: understanding how they think, where current tools leave them exposed, and translating that into a product direction others can act on.

- Driving a shared understanding of where these product areas are going and why. Engineering, design, R&D, and commercial counterparts should all be able to articulate the strategy and the reasoning behind it.

- Producing written narratives, strategy docs, and PRDs, that move decisions forward and give your team the context to build the right thing without a follow-up conversation.

- Balancing short-term delivery with long-term product health: scoping to reflect execution risk, hitting milestones predictably, and iterating based on evidence rather than opinion.

- Contributing to improvements in product practice across the team, and actively participating in PM hiring.

- Du verantwortest deinen eigenen Funnel vom Erstkontakt bis zum Abschluss.

- Du planst deine Woche eigenverantwortlich, mit klaren Zielen und einer Führungskraft, die dich unterstützt und weiterentwickelt.

- Du gibst dein Wissen weiter - im Roleplay, im Shadowing und im Austausch mit Kolleg:innen, die neu dabei sind.

DAS BRINGST DU MIT

- Nachweisbare Erfahrung im B2B-Vertrieb mit eigener Abschlussverantwortung über den gesamten Sales-Cycle hinweg, von der Kaltakquise bis zum Closing.

- Du bist es gewohnt, an KPIs gemessen zu werden und hast deine eigenen Zahlen stets im Blick.

- Du schaffst es, ein komplexes Produkt verständlich zu vermitteln und dabei zu begeistern.

- Du bist lernbereit, setzt Feedback um und willst dich weiterentwickeln.

- Du bist sicher im Umgang mit digitalen Tools.

- Verhandlungssicheres bis muttersprachliches Deutsch sowie gute Englischkenntnisse.

- Führerschein der Klasse B und Freude daran, in deiner Region unterwegs zu sein.

DAS ERWARTET DICH BEI UNS

- Klare Entwicklungschancen: Nächste Senioritätsstufen erreichst du mit deiner Performance - simpel gehalten und schnell erreichbar. Außerdem besetzen wir Team-Lead-Rollen bevorzugt aus dem eigenen Team und begleiten den Weg dorthin mit unserer Sales Manager Academy.

- Ein Team vor Ort: Team Lead und Kolleg:innen in deiner Region - du startest nicht allein.

- Strukturierte Einarbeitung und praxisnahe Begleitung über die ersten Monate hinweg (Ramp-Up Programm).

- Klare KPIs & Performance-Transparenz, damit du jederzeit weißt, wo du stehst.

- Eigenverantwortliche Wochenplanung und Vertrauensarbeitszeit.

- Firmenwagen inkl. Tankkarte sowie MacBook und iPhone.

- 50 € steuerfreies Guthaben pro Monat über Probonio.

- Fixgehalt und ungedeckelte Provision.

- Teamevents, die den Namen verdienen: Sommerfest, Winterfeier und regelmäßige Team-Formate.

WIE GEHT ES WEITER?

1. Bewerbung & Sichtung - wir melden uns so schnell wie möglich bei dir.

2. Erstgespräch mit unserem Recruiting-Team (ca. 30-45 Minuten).

3. Video-Call mit deiner künftigen Führungskraft.

4. Field Day - zwei Stunden bei uns im Office. Du siehst, wie wir arbeiten, wir sehen dich in Aktion.

5. Abschlussgespräch mit unserer Head of Sales.

Salonkee steht für Chancengleichheit und Vielfalt. Wir freuen uns über Bewerbungen von Menschen mit unterschiedlichen Hintergründen, Perspektiven und Fähigkeiten - unabhängig von Geschlecht, Herkunft, Alter, Behinderung, Religion oder Identität.

title: Executive Assistant & Office Manager
description:
Who we are:

We strategically partner with our clients to leverage our expertise in design and software, while our clients bring their own domain expertise. We work with a variety of clients from different industries, collaborating as we get new products to market, modernizing legacy systems, or helping teams learn the skills they need to be successful.

Our values:

Listen first • We are experts in product practices but life long learners in the domain of our customers. We research, collaborate, and understand.
Learn why • We ask questions and talk to users to understand problem spaces, objectives, and goals, which allows us to deeply invest and drive towards the outcomes of our clients.
Love your craft • We love diving into a variety of domains and solving problems. We take pride in delivering value, in communicating progress, and guiding our clients to success.

At Focused, we care about building culture as much as building software. This role runs our 10-person Denver office and serves as right hand to our CEO. As the role grows, you'll take on operations across all Focused offices.

What would you be doing?

• Getting to know everyone in the office, what they like, what they don't, and what they need, and keeping the office stocked with snacks, drinks, and supplies to match

• Supporting personal and family logistics, family travel, and nonprofit board work

• As workload allows, taking on events and offsites, onboarding and offboarding logistics, and gifting and celebrations across all Focused offices

We are excited about you, because you:

• Have 3+ years as an executive assistant, office manager, or in a similar role supporting a senior leader

• Are warm and energetic, with clear writing and discretion around confidential business and personal information

• Have a reliable vehicle, valid driver's license, and auto insurance, plus the ability to carry supplies up to 25 lbs

Nice to have:

• Experience supporting a founder or CEO

• Experience planning events

• Experience supporting nonprofit board work

If you had worked at Focused over the last 3 months you may have:

• Stocked the office around what each person actually likes

• Booked a multi-city business trip and a family vacation in the same week

• This is a full-time, hourly position based in our LoDo office in Denver.

title: VSO Job Description
description:
Before the detail, here's the challenge you'd help us solve.

We build the embodied intelligence that moves real vehicles safely, and the ecosystem a billion machines will run on in the future. Very few people in AI can say this. Every role here, whatever the team, plugs into that.

Here’s what this particular role covers.

🛠️ About our Fleet Operations Team

Our Fleet Operations Team is responsible for maintaining the safety, performance, and operational readiness of Wayve's autonomous vehicle fleet - from routine servicing and diagnostics to urgent repairs and vehicle readiness for high-visibility events. The team keeps our fleet in peak condition to support testing, demonstrations, and real-world deployment, working closely with engineering, drivers, and operations teams to keep autonomy moving forward, every single day.

 

🧠 Your day-to-day
If you're passionate about driving, technology, and the future of mobility, this role offers a rare opportunity to work at the forefront of autonomous driving development.

As a Vehicle Safety Operator, you will support the development of next-generation AI driving systems by operating Wayve vehicles on public roads, evaluating vehicle behaviour, and providing operational feedback to engineering teams. You will act as a critical bridge between real-world driving conditions and the engineers developing Wayve's AI systems.

 

🧩 What you'll be working on

- Support real-world autonomous vehicle testing operations across Japan.

- Safely monitor autonomous driving systems during on-road testing and intervene whenever required.

- Provide structured operational feedback to engineers and research teams to help improve AI driving performance.

- Support data collection and validation activities that contribute to the training and improvement of Wayve's AI systems.

- Maintain high operational and safety standards while accurately reporting vehicle, testing, or safety-related issues.

🙌 You should apply if

Essential:

- You hold a full, clean Japanese driving license, held for a minimum of 5 years.

- You have strong driving experience in Japan and confidence operating in complex urban environments.

- You have no blameworthy insurance claims in the past three years.

- You have strong communication skills in Japanese and can remain calm and professional under pressure.

- You're happy working alone and equally happy working within a team.

- You're adaptable, reliable, and comfortable operating in evolving environments and processes.

- You're proficient in Microsoft Office suite or equivalent (Google Suite).

- You're comfortable using smartphones, tablets, and standard workplace software tools - connecting to Wi-Fi and managing settings (brightness, volume, Bluetooth), using basic apps (e.g., Safari, Mail, Photos, Calendar), and troubleshooting common issues (app crashes, restarts, network resets).

Desirable:

- You have an advanced driving background (ADI, Emergency Response Advanced Driver, or similar driving qualifications).

- You have strong familiarity with driving across urban and highway environments in Japan.

Additional requirements:

- Operations run 7 days a week, including mornings, evenings, weekends, and occasional travel support. Shift schedules (rota) are issued at least 4 weeks in advance wherever possible.

- Shift pattern: Monday to Sunday, 40 hours per week/weekend (must be able to work weekends) - 06:30-15:30 or 14:30-23:30.

- Vehicle Safety Operators are expected to primarily work from one of our operational sites in Yokohama or Tokyo, with occasional travel to support operations (as much notice as possible will be given). Please consider your commute carefully to ensure you can consistently arrive on time.

- All applicants are required to disclose any second job as part of the application process.

- All applicants are subject to a health check before/after.

- Employment is contingent on passing training, pre-employment checks and ongoing drug/alcohol testi

title: Strategischer Einkäufer Neuprodukte
description: Über uns Kijimea - Aus der Forschung. Für Dein Leben. Seit unserer Gründung im Jahr 2011 verfolgen wir eine klare Vision: Wir möchten das Potenzial der Mikrobiota (Bakterien) in unserem Darm gezielt nutzen für ein längeres und gesünderes Leben - für alle Menschen. Ein erster großer Meilenstein auf diesem Weg gelang uns bereits 2013 mit der Entdeckung und klinischen Erforschung des einzigartigen Bakterienstamms B. bifidum MIMBb75 ( Kijimea Reizdarm ). Seitdem konnten wir das Leben von Millionen Reizdarmpatienten weltweit spürbar verbessern. Heute gehört B. bifidum MIMBb75 zu den am besten erforschten Bakterienstämmen weltweit. Seine Wirksamkeit und sein einzigartiger Wirkmechanismus wurden in zahlreichen klinischen Studien nachgewiesen und publiziert - u.a. in renommierten Fachzeitschriften wie The Lancet . Wir arbeiten mit führenden Forschungsinstitutionen wie der Charité Berlin zusammen, um die Zusammenhänge zwischen der Mikrobiota (Bakterien in unserem Darm) und Allergien, Hautkrankheiten und psychischen Störungen zu erforschen. Kurz gesagt: Wir untersuchen, wie die Bakterien in unserem Darm Einfluss auf ein längeres und gesünderes Leben nehmen. Heute zählen wir zu den am schnellsten wachsenden Healthcare-Unternehmen weltweit. Unsere Kunden erreichen wir über verschiedenste Kanäle: über die direkte Kommunikation mit Ärzten und Apothekern sowie Print-, TV- und Digitalmarketing. Um unser stark wachsendes Geschäft in Europa weiter auszubauen, suchen wir herausragende Talente, die uns bei dieser Mission unterstützen. Unser Ziel ist klar definiert: Bis 2028 wollen wir Kijimea zur weltweit größten DTC-Probiotikamarke machen und damit jährlich über 50 Millionen Menschen ein besseres Leben schenken. title: Contract Management Specialist
description:
About The Company:

Sungrow North America is a leading provider of renewable energy solutions, specializing in the development and manufacturing of photovoltaic inverters and energy storage systems. The company offers a comprehensive range of products and services designed to optimize the performance and efficiency of solar power installations. Sungrow North America aims to provide sustainable and reliable energy solutions to meet the growing demand for clean power and is known for its commitment to innovation, high-quality standards, and exceptional customer service.

Job Description:

We're looking for a Service Contract Management Specialist to join our team to contribute to our rapid expansion. As a direct report to the Manager of Service BD, this pivotal role stands as a cornerstone within our services team. The role encompasses spearheading contract development and management across the North America markets and serves as the primary interface with our clients.

Core Responsibilities:

• Formulate and apply contract management strategies and procedures that are in harmony with company ambitions.

• Establish and upkeep comprehensive databases for Service contract components.

• Collaborate with Service and Sales teams to distill best practices and advocate for procedural enhancements to boost efficiency.

• Analyze and address Service stipulations within Master Service Agreements and Individual Service Agreements alongside clients.

• Work alongside the Sales department to negotiate and finalize non-standard contract terms.

• Oversee the complete contract cycle: from drafting and evaluation to endorsement and finalization.

• Interface with Service and Maintenance teams to cater to specific Long-Term Service Agreement requirements for photovoltaic and battery storage setups.

• Verify that all service scopes in the Statement of Work and associated Exhibits are accurately reflected in the final pricing.

• Engage in the examination and negotiation of subcontractor agreements and oversee warranty document amendments.

• Validate approvals for custom service scopes or modifications to the standard offerings.

• Address contract-related disputes, claims, and terminations proactively.

• Maintain robust communication channels to preempt potential issues or emerging needs.

• Ensure meticulous contract documentation within the company's database.

Qualifications:

• Acutely detail-focused with a keen grasp of opportunity subtleties and interdependent services.

• Proficient in managing international clientele with varied expectations.

• Exceptional communication prowess, both in writing and speech.

• Devoted to the company's ethos, leadership principles, and an ethos of continuous growth.

• A proactive analyst with meticulous attention to detail.

• Resilient performance under pressure and within condensed timelines.

• Thrive in a brisk, dynamic, and diverse cultural setting.

• Solid comprehension of sales dynamics and project delivery methodologies.

• Exceptional organizational and troubleshooting abilities.

• Capable of handling multiple complex initiatives across various domains.

• Experienced with Microsoft Office Suite, especially Excel and PowerPoint, among other related applications.

Experience & Travel:

• A minimum of 3 years in contract administration is essential.

• Prior involvement in the Service and renewable energy sectors is advantageous.

• Willingness to accompany the sales team for on-site sales support as necessary.

Compensation & Perks:

• Compensation in line with expertise.

• An attractive suite of benefits and staff initiatives.

• Numerous personal development and company advancement prospects.

Work Location and Status:

• Contract-to-Hire role

• Remote or Hybrid in Houston, TX

For candidates in the states of California, Colorado, New York and Washington, the anticipated annual base salary for this role is between $50,000 - $95,000 This range does not include any other compensation comp

title: Senior Software Engineer, Nexus Server
description:
SUMMARY

As a Senior Engineer, you will get the chance to design, build, and maintain significant portions of our backend functionality for highly scalable, multi-tenant Nexus https://temporal.io/blog/announcing-nexus-connect-temporal-applications-across-isolated-namespaces services (Our durable execution framework for orchestrating work across team and application boundaries for improved modularity, security, debugging, and fault isolation). Examples of the key distributed systems components you’ll own include durable execution, async processing and expand our ability to invoke workflows through more industry standard protocols. Working in the highly collaborative Compute and Artificial Intelligence org, we’ll look to build a new enterprise offering that involves both on-premise and dedicated cloud offerings.

To learn more about Nexus and how our customers use Nexus here https://docs.temporal.io/evaluate/features/nexus#how-teams-use-nexus - [new window opens]

WHAT YOU'LL DO

- Design and implement core backend service features for Nexus https://temporal.io/blog/announcing-nexus-connect-temporal-applications-across-isolated-namespaces.

- Provide appropriate test coverage for unit, integration, and performance for your feature ownership area.

- Clearly document design choices and operational knowledge to successfully deploy and run service with those features.

- Provide appropriate service level logs and metrics to make features operational for cloud service setup.

- Provide appropriate alerts, dashboards, and runbooks for production.

What You Won’t Do

- Work in an office (unless you want to, but you’d be by yourself). Temporal is a fully-remote company.

- Commit code that’s poorly-tested or works “most of the time”. Temporal aspires to be “Reliable as Gravity”, and we expect your code to be the same.

- Work behind closed doors. The SDKs are open source-that means PRs and comments are open to the public, too. See Temporal Git here https://github.com/temporalio/temporal.

- Sit in meetings all day. We mostly communicate in writing, and use meetings mainly for status updates and thorny issues that need input from the whole group.

WHAT YOU'LL BRING

- At least 6 years of experience in a production environment as an "Arranger" and/or "Builder/Enhancer" of highly scalable distributed systems. see HERE https://temporalio.notion.site/Distributed-Systems-Concurrency-2526e6dfce4947d39fd3a40f9f07652a for more info re: "Arranger" and/or "Builder/Enhancer"

- Solid computer science fundamentals in distributed systems concepts including multi-threading and concurrency.

- 2+ years experience developing customer facing APIs and Frameworks

- Experience writing concurrent code in production with languages like Go or Java or other applicable languages with skill level as "high end of Intermediate" and/or "Advanced" or "Expert" levels. see HERE https://temporalio.notion.site/Distributed-Systems-Concurrency-2526e6dfce4947d39fd3a40f9f07652a for more info re: "high end of Intermediate" and/or "Advanced" or "Expert levels"

title: Senior Counsel - Patent Medicinal/Pharmaceutical Chemistry
description:
Career Category
Law/Legal Job Description
Join Amgen ’s Mission of Serving Patients
At Amgen , if you feel like you’re part of something bigger, it’s because you are. Our shared mission-to serve patients living with serious illnesses-drives all that we do.
Since 1980, we’ve helped pioneer the world of biotech in our fight against the world’s toughest diseases. With our focus on four therapeutic areas -Oncology, Inflammation, General Medicine, and Rare Disease- we reach millions of patients each year. Amgen is advancing a broad and deep pipeline of medicines to treat cancer, heart disease, inflammatory conditions, rare diseases, and obesity and obesity-related conditions. As a member of the Amgen team, you’ll help make a lasting impact on the lives of patients as we research, manufacture, and deliver innovative medicines to help people live longer, fuller happier lives.
Our award-winning culture is collaborative, innovative, and science based. If you have a passion for challenges and the opportunities that lay within them, you’ll thrive as part of the Amgen team. Join us and transform the lives of patients while transforming your career.
Senior Counsel - Patent Medicinal/Pharmaceutical Chemistry
What you will do

Let’s do this. Let’s change the world. In this vital role you will develop, implement, and execute global intellectual property strategies for Amgen ’s therapeutic products and product candidates (e.g., small molecules and peptides), related to, for example, compositions, polymorphs, formulations, processes, and methods of manufacturing.
The Senior Counsel will work individually and in legal teams and on cross-functional R&D and business teams across various geographies.

This Senior Counsel position can be remotely located , or work from one of these Amgen locations: Thousand Oaks, CA; Cambridge, MA; or South San Francisco (CA) .

Responsibilities will include:

• Working with Amgen scientists to identify patentable subject matter

• Drafting, filing, and prosecuting patent applications worldwide

• Conducting prior art searches

• Analyzing patents and preparing freedom-to-operate opinions

• Conducting due diligence in support of licensing activities

• Negotiating and drafting research agreements

• Providing legal advice and counsel to R&D and business partners on a variety of IP related matters

• Assisting with litigation-related matters and challenging/defending patents in PTAB, opposition, and other forums.

What we expect of you
We are all different, yet we all use our unique contributions to serve patients. The dynamic professional we seek is a highly collaborative subject matter expert with these qualifications.

Basic Qualifications

• J.D. degree or LL.M. degree from an accredited law school, admission to practice law in a U.S. jurisdiction;
and

• Four plus (4+) years of experience practicing intellectual property law;
and

• Registered to practice before the U.S. Patent and Trademark Office

Preferred Qualifications

• Ten (10) or more years of experience practicing patent or intellectual property law

Our upskilling apprenticeships are designed for people of any age and career stage to build critical AI, data, and tech skills. Our learners have driven $2bn+ ROI for their employers, using the skills they’ve learned to improve productivity and measurable performance.

In April 2026, we announced $70 million in strategic funding, led by Schroders Capital, with participation from StepStone Group, Lightspeed Venture Partners and General Catalyst. At an increased valuation of $2.1bn, the round makes us Europe’s first EdTech double unicorn.

But we aren’t stopping there. With a strong operational footprint and 800+ employees, we have ambitious plans to continue scaling. We’re building a world where tech skills unlock people’s potential and output.

Join Multiverse and power our mission to equip the workforce to win in the AI era.

THE ROLE:

Multiverse’s mission is to equip the workforce to win in the AI era. Joining us means being part of a talented team, tackling the challenges of being in a scaling organisation solving complex problems, whilst contributing to our company and product growth. As a team, we always prioritise quality - you’ll hold the hiring bar whilst keeping pipeline moving when there’s commercial pressure to move fast.

As a Talent Partner, you’ll be growing your experience as a trusted advisor to hiring managers, and own end-to-end recruitment for the roles you’re responsible for. You’ll show up prepared with market knowledge, using it to set realistic expectations on timelines, candidate availability and what the market will and won’t accept, and adjusting your approach when conditions change. You’ll use pipeline data to spot where a process is breaking down and fix it. You use AI to power your productivity, and focus your time on what AI can’t do: building strong stakeholder relationships, giving candidates an exceptional experience and building connections.

Teams you’ll support: Operations - this is our learner-facing org who work day-in-day-out to give our apprentices a great learning experience and provide measurable impact to our customers; and G&A - our core business partnering teams across People and Talent, Finance, Legal, CEO Office and Comms.

If you have experience as a recruiter or Talent Partner, ideally somewhere with a high talent bar, and are genuinely excited about being at the forefront of a fast-evolving recruiting role, we’d love for you to apply.

WHAT YOU’LL DO:

- Run recruiting for your roles end-to-end: attraction and sourcing, qualifying and hiring top talent for Multiverse. We have a high hiring bar, and you’ll partner closely with managers to assess the market, calibrate regularly, build rigour into our assessment and make pivots based on data.

- Partner with hiring managers to expertly qualify requirements, challenge assumptions using market data and past hiring experience, and build a shared understanding of what good looks like.

- Design structured interview and assessment processes for the roles you own.

- Be an exceptional operator, running processes that focus on the very highest quality of hire as we scale, and make the most of your tech stack to do so. We invest in great tools (Ashby, Claude, Gemini, Juicebox, Brighthire, LinkedIn) to support you. You’ll source through these platforms and build your own network and referrals.

- Manage candidate relationships end-to-end: anticipating candidates’ needs and questions, tailoring your communication to their profile and stage in the pipeline, building buy-in and providing high quality, timely feedback. You’ll own candidate experience and maintain strong NPS, and build talent pools from silver medallists.

title: Director, AI & Data Science
description:
DIRECTOR, AI & DATA SCIENCE
Data Engineering & Analytics, AI, and Data Science | Full-Time, Salaried | Player-Coach | Reports to the Co-CEOs

Company

Seeking.com (Reflex Media)

Location

Remote, anywhere in the USA

Team

Six to seven individual contributors across data engineering, analytics, data science, ML, and MLOps

Education

Bachelor’s degree in a technical field required. Master’s or PhD preferred.

Compensation

$175,000 to $225,000 base

Schedule

Collaboration across time zones. Regular working-hour overlap with our Singapore Dev team and partners is required.

Travel

Required for team weeks and quarterly planning in Las Vegas

About the Role
Seeking.com is the world's largest premium dating platform, founded and led by an MIT alumnus and headquartered in Las Vegas. We are a lean company of about 60 people, so every leader here builds.
You will lead our combined Data Engineering & Analytics, AI, and Data Science team of six to seven individual contributors and report directly to the Co-CEOs. This team is Seeking's central AI capability: the models, infrastructure, evaluation frameworks, and continuous-learning systems the whole company runs on. Expect about half your time leading and half writing code, building models, and debugging production systems yourself.
Your first mandate is to achieve 100% AI automation of routine user-uploaded content moderation, with accuracy proven superior to our human moderators and at a lower total cost. Next is AI customer support that resolves member tickets end to end. You own both outcomes completely, from policy and data through production results.
Over time, the team will extend AI to fraud prevention, matching, member onboarding and success, marketing, monetization, retention, and product development, in partnership with the leaders who own those areas. Every initiative carries a measurable target, a named owner, and a mechanism for continuous learning. The immediate problems come first, and this role exists to solve them.
This role is for someone who manages a hands-on team today and still ships code. If your recent roles had managers reporting to you, or you plan to delegate the technical work and manage through status meetings, this is the wrong role. If you walk into ambiguity and know exactly what to do, keep reading.
What You Will Do
1. Set the foundation in your first 30 days

• Bring Product, Support, and Operations to one written moderation policy with a single owner. When teams disagree, you run the process that settles it.

• Inventory every production AI system with a named owner, backup, dependencies, and monitoring gaps.

• Trace every upload from receipt through model decision, enforcement, and any human review. Quantify every path that still needs a human, with its root cause, cost, and fix.

2. Prove AI beats our human moderators, then reach 100%

• Test the AI and our moderators on the same held-out cases, with reference decisions set by independent, policy-qualified reviewers. Report missed violations and wrongful rejections separately, with sample sizes and confidence intervals.

• Close every gap: missing coverage, uncertain model outputs, system failures, unenforced decisions, and duplicate human review. Expand automation in controlled stages, each with a tested rollback.

3. Build systems that keep getting better

• Every production system improves through verified feedback, independent evaluation, and controlled releases. Run a monthly learning cycle in which a new model ships only when it beats production on the same independent test.

• Version every dataset, policy, prompt, and model so every gain can be proven and every change can be rolled back.

4. Run production AI like a business

• Give every production AI system monitoring, alerts to a named owner, documented recovery, and regular failure drills.

• Report results in business terms: quality, cost per outcome, revenue, efficiency, and member experience, with savings reconciled with Finance.

title: Senior Actuarial Analyst
description:
About the Role
Location: Fully remote within the continental United States.
Use of AI data in insurance pricing entails regulatory review by state departments of insurance. When a carrier intends to use Nearmap data in its rates, both the carrier’s own actuaries and state insurance regulators can come back with various questions and/or objections. Many are predictable and specific: how was ground truth for an attribute determined, what do the goodness-of-fit metrics look like on held-out data? Others have never been asked before and have yet to be fully answered.
You will be the actuarial voice inside Nearmap ’s and our customers’ rate filings. Working with our AI and Computer Vision team, you will build a library of validation materials behind every Nearmap attribute and score used in rating, produce exhibits and memos for state DOI review, and answer regulator objections with analysis that holds up under scrutiny.
This is a customer-facing actuarial role, not a back-office one. You will report into Insurance Product and work alongside our regulatory affairs owner, who owns regulator relationships and submission mechanics, so your time goes to the analysis and the defense of it.
Key Responsibilities
You’ll own and defend the filing evidence:

• Coordinate on and collaborate with cross functional teams to produce the filing materials for each Nearmap attribute and score used in rating: model memos, validation and accuracy metrics, and the actuarial exhibits that go into a submission.

• Document and maintain what each state requires for model validation, including details on state-by-state confidentiality and trade secret treatments, ensuring Nearmap consistently produces exhibits that satisfies the NAIC checklist for model filings

• Turn model outputs into the evidence that filings need, such as model validation metrics, coverage rates, distributional analysis, bias and fairness testing, and by-state breakdowns. Lead the analytical response to regulator objections, working with our regulatory affairs owner on strategy, framing, and submission, and join calls with departments of insurance to explain methodology and results directly.

• Manage administration of Nearmap ’s filings including creating and maintaining SERFF accounts and keeping good records of all Nearmap filing materials and exchanges.

You'll work directly with customers:

• Advise on which attributes are filing-ready and which carry approval risk and build supporting materials to enable the GTM teams and customers ahead of time.

• Partner with carrier actuarial and pricing teams on how Nearmap data is best implemented in their rating plans.

• Collaborate with pre-sales to support data tests and lift analyses that demonstrate predictive value and help turn the results into something a filing can use.

You'll make the next filing cheaper than the last:

• Build reusable validation templates and exhibits so each new carrier program costs less effort than the one before it.

• Establish product requirements for new products and scores before they ship that makes them “filing ready” immediately upon release.

Experience

• 5+ years of property and casualty actuarial experience, with real exposure to pricing, ratemaking, or rate filings.

• ACAS or FCAS credentialing strongly preferred for this role. Candidates with substantial ratemaking and filing experience will be considered.

• Experience preparing actuarial exhibits for rate filings and responding to regulator objections.

• Bachelor's degree in actuarial science, statistics, mathematics, economics, or a related field.

Skills

• You can explain carrier-led rate filing processes to someone who is not an actuary without making them feel lost.

• You are comfortable with predictive model output, including GLMs, gradient boosting, and the validation statistics that go with them.

• You have worked with large claims and exposure data using standard tooling including SQL, R, or Python.

Platform Administration & Governance
